programme.title: Smiley Face Killers
programme.desc: Un joueur de foot se sent poursuivi par quelque chose, quelqu'un.

programme.title: Sinister Squad
programme.desc: Face à un culte surnaturel menaçant la Terre, Alice recrute des méchants de contes pour combattre la mort.

programme.title: Blockbusters 80
programme.desc: "Blockbusters 80" nous replonge dans les films d'action iconiques des années 80, symboles d'une époque.

programme.title: Serieously Ep.30
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Le Chemin du passé
programme.desc: Des années après la disparition d'un scientifique, sa famille trouve un indice pouvant le ramener chez lui.

programme.title: Serieously Ep.22
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Vice
programme.desc: VICE est un resort dans lequel les personnes peuvent assouvir leurs fantasmes.

programme.title: Le plan d'Amber
programme.desc: Irlande, milieu des années 90. Eddie et Amber se font passer pour un couple afin de faire taire les rumeurs qui circulent autour de leur sexualité.

programme.title: Entre les jambes
programme.desc: Tout commence lors d'une réunion des sexopathes anonymes où Javier et Miranda se rencontrent. Javier, scénariste-producteur, avait un avenir brillant jusqu'au jour où il s'est livré à un jeu sexuel au téléphone qui a détruit son mariage et Miranda, animatrice d'une émission radio.

programme.title: Love, Romance & Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de Chocolatier Rayal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolats uniques, mais gagneront-t-ils sans qu'ils y perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: Black/White
programme.desc: Theresa ramène son fiancé Simon Green à la maison, pour le 25e anniversaire de mariage de ses parents, mais elle a oublié de mentionner un détail : il est blanc. Bien déterminé à mettre fin aux fiançailles de sa fille, Percy Jones va prouver qu'un père n'a pas toujours raison.

programme.title: Troppa grazia
programme.desc: Lucia, mère célibataire, lutte pour trouver le bon équilibre entre sa fille adolescente, une histoire d'amour compliquée et sa carrière de géomètre. Son avenir professionnel est compromis lorsqu'elle réalise que la future construction d'un immeuble ambitieux s'avère dangereuse pour l'environnement en raison des cartes topographiques inexactes du conseil municipal.

programme.title: Women in Trouble
programme.desc: Un jour dans la vie de 10 femmes à priori très différentes : une star du porno, une hôtesse de l'air, une psychiatre, une masseuse, une serveuse, deux call-girls, etc. Toutes ont un point commun : l'ennui.

programme.title: Le Noël du cœur
programme.desc: Après avoir gagné un prix de 50 000 dollars, un homme décide de rendre la pareille en achetant des cadeaux de Noël à des inconnus sous le pseudonyme de « Lucky the Elf ».

programme.title: WELCOME BACK, MISS MARY
programme.desc: Joey Vitello, un jeune homme de vingt ans sans but, vit toujours chez ses parents au sein de sa famille italo-américaine haute en couleur. Il retrouve Mary O'Callahan, une camarade d'enfance autrefois surnommée Mary la Terrifiante . Celle qui était un vilain petit canard est devenue une beauté irrésistible, de retour dans le quartier après avoir vaincu un cancer. Lorsque Joey découvre que sa guérison est due à un miracle, leur amitié se transforme en romance, et Mary l'initie à la foi. Les nouvelles convictions de Joey bouleversent la foi de sa famille, et le chaos s'installe alors que chacun part à la recherche de son propre miracle.

programme.title: Le Voyage Fantastique: Des Freres Bodganov
programme.desc: Le Voyage Fantastique: Des Freres Bodganov - Épisode 02: Une série innovante qui éclaire des sujets captivants : 1- Sommes-nous seuls dans l'univers? Explorez la possibilité de communiquer avec d'autres mondes. 2- Risques cosmiques : Les rayons gamma, les supervolcans et les inversions des pôles magnétiques peuvent-ils détruire la Terre? 3- Le côté caché du cerveau: Nouvelles théories basées sur des individus uniques avec une puissance cérébrale incroyable.

programme.title: Nom de Code: Geronimo
programme.desc: Inspiré de faits réels : cette saga héroïque raconte l'incursion d'une équipe d'élite anti-terroriste en Irak, quatre jours avant l'Opération Bouclier du Désert, et les conséquences terribles que ses membres ont subies lorsque leur mission secrète a été compromise.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: The New Captain Scarlet - Épisode 06: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: Secteur 4
programme.desc: Nash Olsen est le chef d'un commando d'élite. Ses membres sont envoyés en mission au coeur d'un camp islamiste : le secteur 4. Alors que les soldats se font capturer, Nash est laissé pour mort. Il parvient à s'échapper mais le gouvernement américain refuse de l'aider à retrouver ses coéquipiers. Il promet d'y retourner et d'agir seul. Là bas, il découvre pourquoi cette mission leur a été confiée.

programme.title: Stalingrad Sniper
programme.desc: Stalingrad Sniper - Stalingrad Sniper Part 1: Le commandant Yashin est envoyé près de Minsk, où il découvre la trace de potentiels missiles au sein de la ville. Le temps presse alors pour les retrouver, d'autant que de mystérieux snipers abattent ceux qui restent à découvert...

programme.title: Mi-Temps Au Mitard
programme.desc: Lorsque Paul Crewe, star du football américain, se retrouve en prison pour fraude sur les matchs, il ne veut plus rien avoir à faire avec ce sport. Mais les gardiens l'obligent à monter une équipe avec les autres détenus. D'un groupe de hors-la-loi disparate, Crewe doit faire une équipe capable d'affronter les gardiens décidés à en découdre.

programme.title: Rock The Kasbah
programme.desc: Un manager musical part en Afghanistan pour une tournée humanitaire avec son tout dernier client. Durant son trajet, il croisera la route d'une adolescente à la voix unique qu'il emmène à Kaboul, lieu d'un célèbre concours de chant télévisuel local intitulé Afghan Star.

programme.title: Garde Rapprochee
programme.desc: Sharp, un Texas Ranger habitué des dossiers sensibles, doit protéger les seuls témoins du meurtre de son indic : cinq pom-pom girls, incontrôlables et survoltées ! Il pensait avoir tout vu. Il va vite déchanter.

programme.title: Excess Baggage
programme.desc: Emily T. Hope, adolescente mal dans sa peau, tente sans succes de retenir l'attention de son cher papa. Devant ses echecs repetes, elle tente le tout pour le tout et organise son propre kidnapping. Son plan reussit. En deguisant sa voix, elle previent son pere de l'endroit ou il peut la retrouver: dans le coffre de sa propre voiture. Mais Vincent Roche, voleur professionnel, vole le vehicule.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artiste de Los Angeles voit sa vie basculer lorsque son exposition d'art est annulée et que sa petite-amie mannequin le quitte.

programme.title: Afternoon delight
programme.desc: Soucieuse de pimenter son mariage, Rachel emmène son mari dans une boîte de strip-tease où ils y rencontrent, une strip-teaseuse et décide de l'embaucher comme nounou ...

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: 10 personnes, 5 voitures, 1 jour… seulement à Los Angeles. « Park » se déroule en une journée, dans un parc public de Los Angeles, alors que 11 résidents mécontents trouvent à la fois l'amour et la perte de façon inattendue.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: Afin de protéger une belle femme et son fils d'un braqueur, l'agent du FBI Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) est chargé d'une opération secrète consistant à se déguiser en femme âgée obèse afin d'enquêter sur un crime antérieur.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: Le Banni
programme.desc: Les légendes occidentales Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday et Billy the Kid s'affrontent pour prévaloir sur la loi et pour gagner les attentions de la vive renarde de campagne, Rio McDonald.

programme.title: Dreamcatcher
programme.desc: Deux soeurs et leurs amis se retrouvent retranchées dans un tourbillon de violence de 48 heures après une expérience traumatisante lors d'un festival de musique underground.

programme.title: Terror Hospital
programme.desc: Un groupe d'étudiants décide de se faire peur le soir d'Halloween en allant visiter un hôpital psychiatrique désaffecté. Hélàs, l'esprit d'un patient, autrefois brûlé vif alors qu'il tentait de s'enfuir, hante les lieux. Le fantôme psychopathe veut par tous les moyens quitter les lieux pour de bon...

programme.title: White Settlers
programme.desc: C'est la première nuit d'Ed et Sarah dans leur nouvelle maison : une ferme isolée à la frontière de l'Ecosse. Alors qu'ils pensaient échapper au stress de leur vie londonienne, le sommeil de Sarah est troublé par des bruits suspects. Leur nouvelle vie se transforme en cauchemar lorsque le couple part faire des investigations dans les bois à la nuit tombée. Ils réalisent alors qu'ils ne sont pas ici chez eux et encore moins les bienvenus.

programme.title: Terror Experiment
programme.desc: Un terroriste déclenche une explosion qui fait basculer le bâtiment fédéral et libère un gaz toxique dans tout le système de ventilation. Son but : exposer l'arme de guerre biologique secrète du gouvernement, un virus mortel qui attaque instantanément le système surrénalien d'une personne, la poussant à devenir inhumainement agressive, avec une envie incontrôlable de s'entretuer.

programme.title: Le Dernier Train de la Nuit
programme.desc: Deux jeunes filles, Carole et Lysa, rendent visite aux parents de l'une d'elles pour Noël. Dans le train de nuit qu'elles empruntent, elles sont agressées par deux hommes sadiques accompagnés d'une femme.

programme.title: Mort En Direct
programme.desc: Le soldat Wyatt Maddox se rend à la maison à l'enterrement de son petit frère pour constater que sa mort n'était pas aussi simple que la police le voudrait. Avec l'aide de Tara, le partenaire en ligne de son frère, il se met à résoudre le mystère sans savoir a quel point l'entreprise est insidieuse

programme.title: 400 Days
programme.desc: Quatre astronautes sont envoyés en mission scientifique de simulation pour tester les effets psychologiques des voyages dans l'espace. Enfermés durant 400 jours dans un simulateur , l'état mental de l'équipage se détériore lorsque qu'ils perdent toute communication avec le monde extérieur.

programme.title: Battlefield
programme.desc: La Terre a complètement succombé à une invasion extraterrestre et la planète est devenue un enfer. Pour arrêter les monstres, des troupes formées par différents pays ont fait fi de leur sécurité personnelle pour défendre ce qui reste.

programme.title: Time Run
programme.desc: Sergey, champion d'athlétisme brisé par un accident, découvre que ses blessures lui permettent de voir le passé quand son cœur s'emballe. Pendant ce temps, l'inspectrice Nastya traque un tueur de femmes dans la ville.

programme.title: Kronos : Le Soulèvement des machines
programme.desc: En 2020, Elias van Dorne, PDG de VA Industries, la plus grande société de robotique mondiale, présente sa plus puissante invention Kronos. Un super ordinateur conçu pour mettre fin aux guerres dans le monde.

programme.desc: La chaine 100% science-fiction et fantastique. Zone réservée aux fans de films et séries SF : catastrophes, zombies, extraterrestres, paranormal, space opéras, vampires, mondes perdus et créatures mutantes sont au programme

programme.title: Stonewall
programme.desc: Des émeutes ont éclaté au bar Stonewall Inn à New York. Cela changera à jamais la lutte pour les droits des homosexuels et donnera naissance par la suite à la première marche des fiertés.

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: Une adaptation de l'histoire de Lizzie Borden, accusée, puis acquittée, pour le double meurtre de son père et de sa belle-mère.

programme.title: Seule contre tous
programme.desc: Kathryn Bolkovac, une policière du Nebraska qui a servi comme gardienne de la paix dans la Bosnie d'après-guerre, dénonce l'ONU pour avoir dissimulé un scandale de trafic sexuel.

programme.title: Reste avec moi
programme.desc: Steffi, 16 ans, vient d'obtenir son diplôme et va partir en voyage avec son copain à Paris. Mais lors d'un bilan médical de routine, les médecins décèlent un cancer incurable : elle n'a plus qu'un an à vivre.

programme.title: The Choke
programme.desc: Les membres du groupe de rock The Choke se réunissent pour leur dernière performance au complet au Club 905. Mais un dangereux serial killer en a décidé autrement : ce club sera également le lieu de leur dernier souffle...

programme.title: 7th Floor
programme.desc: Un père se lance dans une recherche désespérée pour retrouver ses enfants qui ont disparu alors qu'ils descendaient les escaliers de leur appartement au septième étage.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Deux frères retournent dans la secte qu'ils ont fui des années auparavant pour découvrir que les croyances du groupe sont peut-être plus saines qu'ils ne le pensaient autrefois.

programme.title: En ce moment sur Box Office Action
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: Rédemption
programme.desc: Un ex-détenu, lié à la mafia russe et à la confrérie aryenne, tente de mener une vie tranquille après avoir passé 15 ans en prison. Ses plans changent lorsque des membres de la mafia le recrutent pour une dernière mission.

programme.title: Parallel Minds
programme.desc: À l'aube de la sortie de Red Eye 2, une lentille de contact révolutionnaire capable d'enregistrer des données et de faire réapparaître des souvenirs enfouis, Margo découvre le programmeur en chef du projet mort.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: Après avoir été ressuscité par une entité sinistre, Art le Clown revient dans la ville de Miles County où il prend pour cible une adolescente et son jeune frère le soir d'Halloween.

programme.title: The Lamp
programme.desc: Un esprit maléfique contenu dans une vieille lampe à l'huile se réveille une nuit où des jeunes gens s'infiltrent dans le musée où elle est exposée.

programme.title: Creuse
programme.desc: Marc, un jeune citadin, part s'installer seul à la campagne. Il compte sur la venue prochaine de sa copine Louise, qui tarde à le rejoindre. Marc est obsédé par la routine « bien-être » qui rythme ses journées, mais le silence se fait de plus en plus pesant, et Louise n'arrive toujours pas. Dans ce calme angoissant, Marc se retrouve peu à peu assailli par des sons que l'on a l'habitude d'ignorer.

programme.title: Uberlinks
programme.desc: Claude et Mahalia ont matché sur une application de rencontre pour personnes dotées de super-pouvoirs. Celui de Claude ? Devenir invisible. Quand Mahalia insiste pour connaître sa première action à la découverte de son pouvoir, Claude fait tout pour fuir la question. De peur de ruiner ses chances avec elle.

programme.title: Mantra
programme.desc: Emma et Paul viennent de s'installer dans une banlieue pavillonnaire de province. À peine les cartons défaits, Paul doit aussitôt partir pour un long voyage d'affaires. Dans son bureau, Emma découvre un insecte perché dans un grand vivarium : une mante religieuse. Cette dernière la répugne autant qu'elle la fascine.

programme.title: Totem VF
programme.desc: Buffle, un ancien scout, n'a toujours pas fait le deuil de son ami disparu il y a vingt ans. En plus de cela, il est constamment hanté par un rat géant… Sa psychologue lui conseille de reformer sa bande en organisant un camp. Mais cette thérapie de groupe va prendre une nouvelle dimension lorsque que nos quadragénaires vont découvrir un passage temporel.

programme.title: Les Bouchers verts
programme.desc: Deux amis décident de monter leur propre boucherie afin d'échapper à un patron étouffant, mais la clientèle se fait rare. La chance tourne à la suite d'un malencontreux accident qui permettra à Svend d'offrir, une recette "maison" : une viande à la saveur très originale mais à l'approvisionnement plus que délicat...

programme.title: Deadly Cargo
programme.desc: Cinq amis partent faire de la plongée sous-marine et découvrent le cadavre d'un homme flottant à la surface. Leur bateau ayant coulé peu après suite à une avarie, ils se retrouvent seuls au milieu de l'océan.

programme.title: The Other Side
programme.desc: Shirin s'installe avec son beau-fils Lucas, hanté par une présence maléfique dans la maison voisine.

programme.title: Abandonnée
programme.desc: Marie hérite en Russie et découvre un double delle-même aux yeux vitreux.

programme.title: The Last Wave
programme.desc: Des inondations extrêmes provoquent des tremblements de terre et tsunamis massifs.

programme.title: War Of Apes
programme.desc: Pour sauver l'humanité, un gigantesque singe et son ennemi mécanique, Mecha Ape MkII, s'allient.

programme.title: The Party Crasher
programme.desc: Sigma Tau, une fraternité étudiante, organise une fête hawaïenne. Rapidement, les jeunes gens réalisent qu'une entité surnaturelle et malveillante a pris possession des lieux.

programme.title: Breeder
programme.desc: Une femme d'affaires sélectionne et enlève des jeunes femmes pour créer son produit miracle, qui permet d'inverser le processus de vieillissement.

programme.title: War Zone
programme.desc: Des soldats néerlandais sont plongés dans une zone de combat en Afghanistan.

programme.title: La ligne de feu
programme.desc: L'histoire de la résistance héroïque des cadets de Podolsk aux abords de Moscou en octobre 1941.

programme.title: Le Maitre Chinois
programme.desc: Le jeune Wong Fei-Hong, enfant indiscipliné, est envoyé apprendre le Kung Fu chez son oncle au caractère très autoritaire. Seule une terrible menace pesant sur son père l'amène à rentrer chez lui.

programme.title: Harcelés
programme.desc: Pour Chris et Lisa, emménager dans leur maison de Lakeview Terrace est un rêve devenu réalité. Pourtant, rapidement, les deux jeunes gens deviennent la cible de leur voisin, qui désapprouve leur relation interraciale. Cet homme strict et austère, père célibataire et policier, s'est autoproclamé responsable de la sécurité du quartier.

programme.title: La Résurrection du Christ
programme.desc: Un agent de la CIA corrompu, Sands, l'engage pour déjouer un complot visant à assassiner le président du Mexique. Ce que Sands ignore, c'est que le Desperado revient uniquement pour se venger. Avec ses 2 comparses, Lorenzo et Fideo, il va raviver sa légende...

programme.title: Escape Game
programme.desc: Dans ESCAPE GAME, le nouveau film d'Adam Robitel (INSIDIOUS : LA DERNIERE CLE), six personnes n'ayant rien en commun se retrouvent enfermées dans un jeu et devront trouver les indices ou mourir.

programme.title: Escape Game 2: Gagner n'était que le début
programme.desc: Six inconnus se retrouvent involontairement enfermés dans une nouvelle succession d'escape games mortels. Au fur et à mesure des énigmes résolues et des indices découverts, ils se découvrent un point commun qui sera la clé de leur survie : tous ont déjà participé à ce jeu auparavant.

programme.title: Sentinelle
programme.desc: Sur une base militaire isolée au bord d'un vaste océan, deux soldats attendent la fin de leur service de deux ans. Lorsqu'il y a un retard et que le navire tant attendu arrive vide, la tension entre eux commence à monter, et la situation devient incontrôlable.

programme.title: House of Boys
programme.desc: Amsterdam, 1984, Frank a 18 ans et décide de quitter le domicile familial pour s'émanciper et vivre sa vie comme il l'entend. Pour survivre, Il devient alors danseur dans le club de strip-tease " House of Boys ".

programme.title: L'enfant loup
programme.desc: En 1954 à Cordoba, au cœur des montagnes de la Sierra Morena, le jeune Marcos qui fût vendu par son père à un berger, va lors du décès de ce dernier, se retrouver complètement seul et isolé du monde, et vivre au milieu des loups pendant plus de 12 ans!

programme.title: Votre programme reprendra rapidement
programme.desc: Nous nous refaisons une beauté ! Restez à l'écoute pour d'autres divertissements inestimables sélectionnés par Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Votre programme reprendra rapidement
programme.desc: Nous nous refaisons une beauté ! Restez à l'écoute pour d'autres divertissements inestimables sélectionnés par Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Remise de peine
programme.desc: Devenu veuf, Frank Fogle entreprend à contrecœur un voyage pour honorer la dernière volonté de sa femme, qui voulait qu'il répande ses cendres sur un lac isolé de son Irlande natale.

programme.title: Extorsion
programme.desc: Les vacances d'une famille aux Caraïbes tournent mal. Le père de famille doit alors retrouver rapidement sa femme et son fils, qui ont été enlevés.

programme.title: Battle of Wits
programme.desc: Une fresque retraçant la série de guerres civiles qui construisit la nation chinoise du cinquième siècle au troisième siècle avant J-C.

programme.title: 11 Septembre
programme.desc: Cinq personnes sont bloquées dans un ascenseur de la tour nord du World Trade Center au matin du 11 septembre 2001. Contraints de se regrouper, ils luttent de toutes leurs forces pour s'échapper avant l'effondrement imminent et inévitable des deux tours.

programme.title: Under Siege
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un agent de la CIA renégat et ses mercenaires s'emparent d'un cuirassé américain pour récupérer ses ogives nucléaires, la seule personne à bord qui puisse sauver la mise est le chef cuisinier, qui se trouve être un ancien Navy SEAL.

programme.title: The Great House Giveaway
programme.desc: BAFTA award-winning series that offers strangers the chance to team up and make money to either buy their first house or invest. They are given cash to buy, renovate and sell a house. Any profit they make, they keep

programme.title: Posh Pawn
programme.desc: A bumper-car collector looking for a loan visits the shop offering an impromptu test drive in the city. Patrick is star-struck when he deals with a bass guitarist who used to play with Eric Clapton.

programme.title: Posh Pawn
programme.desc: In this Christmas Special, James shocks the team by offering free valuations for charity. Caprice sells a designer dress for a worthy cause. And the staff prepare for their Christmas party.

programme.title: Bangkok Airport
programme.desc: With its helpful staff, and word-class signage, Bangkok Airport prides itself on being one of the most tourist-friendly airports in the world. But not today…

programme.title: Bangkok Airport
programme.desc: Love is in the air at Bangkok Airport as staff celebrate Valentines Day, one of the biggest dates in the Thai calendar. Romance blossoms for Immigration Officers Bert and Nat, while loved up Capt. Jack is still glowing after his recent nuptials.

programme.title: Conan O Brien TV
programme.desc: All the political dirt, Hollywood gossip, and tawdry affairs of the cultural elite squeezed into one half hour of scandalous yellow journalism at its award-winning finest.

programme.title: Conan O Brien TV
programme.desc: Conan and company serve up a tasty charcuterie of that essential comedy staple - the impression!

programme.title: Bryan Johnson
programme.desc: Bryan Johnson is an entrepreneur and anti-aging pioneer who uses an algorithmic and automotive approach to optimal health and ageing. He goes in-depth about his life and why he thinks ageing isn't inevitable.

programme.title: Christmas Comes Home
programme.desc: A widowed Texas farmer invites his new love home to meet the family for Christmas, only to discover the joys of the season mask a much deeper yearning.

programme.title: Love Always, Santa
programme.desc: When seven-year-old Lilly writes a letter to "Santa," aka children's book author Jake, she wishes for her mother Celia to find love again. After Celia reads the heartfelt response, the two begin a romantic correspondence just in time for the holidays.

programme.title: The March Sisters At Christmas
programme.desc: To keep the family home from being sold, four sisters tackle home improvement. But their romantic entanglements soon become a distraction.

programme.title: Christmas For Three
programme.desc: Christmas For Three

programme.title: Girlfriends Of Christmas Past
programme.desc: Livvy is heartbroken when her boyfriend dumps her for another girl he's already seeing. She finds two more of his exes and the trio work together to get revenge. Along the way, Livvy meets Carter, and sparks fly. Can she forget about revenge long enough to let a Christmas romance blossom?

programme.title: Hypothetical

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a sub-continent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness. The 4,000km between the coasts are made up of a patchwork of contrasting landscapes: tropical rainforests, snow-capped mountains, dry woodland, giant wetlands, tropical reefs and hostile desert. These vast tracts of wilderness boast the world's most unique and bizarre wildlife communities. In this ‘hidden' Australia, there is an astonishing surprise at every turn.

programme.title: Lake Magic
programme.desc: Mini land-bound oceans, lakes are a treasure trove of aquatic wonders. Lakes make up just 3% of the Earth's surface, but they hold 180,000 square kilometres of fresh water. From the shoreline to their depths are unique habitats teaming with life, home to everything from birds and bugs to frogs and fish. They can be anything from sanctuary from land predators and temperature regulators to bountiful food sources and pit-stops for migrating birdlife. Take a deep breath and dive into the magical world of lakes!

programme.title: The Woman Who Loves Giraffes
programme.desc: Dr. Anne Innis Dagg re-traces the steps of her ground-breaking 1956 journey to South Africa to study giraffes in the wild. Now, at 85 years old, Anne sees a startling contrast between the world of giraffes she once knew and the one it has become. Weaving through the past and present, her harrowing journey gives us an intimate look into the factors that destroyed her career and the forces that brought her back.

programme.title: Magical Fjords
programme.desc: Fjords are one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth. But for all their beauty and majesty, the surface spectacle is just the tip of the iceberg.

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw – animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight. Winning these battles will make the difference between life and death, and with the stakes so high don't be surprised if the biggest animals don't have everything their own way. Welcome to nature's fight club.

programme.title: Tundra
programme.desc: What at first it can seem an icy wasteland, the tundra is actually a tapestry of interconnected life creatures relying on one another to survive the long winter.

programme.title: Close to Death
programme.desc: One of the oddest natural adaptations is super-deep sleep. These near-death experiences feature animals temporarily stopping their hearts and brains others can hibernate for months at a time while some can freeze themselves, employing a natural anti-freeze to keep their cells intact. But as we explore this natural time travel, we also discover that this lifestyle is not without risks…

programme.title: Polar Bear Family
programme.desc: The ultimate icons of polar wilderness, able to withstand the harshest environments and remain a top predator the lives of polar bears are nothing short of remarkable!

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Photographer Matthias Ziegler is an Africa specialist. He has visited nearly every country on the continent on assignments for international agencies. Zanzibar, however, is new territory for him. He's come to the former slave island for a photo book – and this time he's not alone. To see the Tanzanian archipelago from the air, he has enlisted the services of ultralight pilot Richard Meredith-Hardy of England to fly him around in his FIB, or flying inflatable boat. Perfect conditions for an adventurous journey: as a world champion ultralight pilot, Richard and his FIB can take off and land practically anywhere – in theory.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Renaud Van Der Meeren is a photographer and paramotor pilot. With his motorised parachute he goes on expeditions to the remotest corners on earth to photograph people and landscapes from the air. Renaud wanted to be a jet pilot, studied music at the Sorbonne, became a ski instructor, model and photographer's assistant before he found happiness in his current vocation. He especially likes to do his job in Mauritius – nowhere else does he find so many motifs as on the "sweetest pearl in the Indian Ocean". This time he's working on a photo book about Mauritius – by land, by water and in the air.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: Majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, raging waterfalls, threatening fjords, mighty glaciers, endless lava fields – there is hardly another country in the world that offers as much impressive nature as Iceland, the remote island in the harsh North Sea. The nature in Iceland is immense! Here, the four elements of nature can be experienced as raw and as close-up as practically no other place on Earth. And nowhere on the northern hemisphere can the origin of life, can growth and decay be experienced as dramatically as here. Besides the impressive nature, we get to know the dramatic history of the Viking culture with its nature-influenced mythology and discuss the negative effects of excessive tourism.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: This documentary is a scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Highway to the Arctic
programme.desc: Every winter, ice roads are built across hundreds of miles in Canada's far north, connecting frozen rivers and lakes, and stretching up to the very northern tip of the country by the Arctic Ocean.

programme.title: Grønland
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.sub-title: Philippines - More fun in the Philippines part 2
programme.desc: The story of cacao is more akin to South America, but in this episode, Sashi tracks the story of cacao in the Philippines, the entry point of cacao in Asia. With his friend, Spanish chef, Chele Gonzalez, they embark on an anthropological exploration tracing how the ancestral varietal cacao (crillio) came to be in the Philippine islands. Visiting farms to mystical islands, to top kitchens in Manila, this is the ‘never-before-told' tale of cacao in the Philippine islands.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.desc: Vietnam offers travelers a wide range of exotic as well as simple homegrown grub. Sashi rolls into town with no knowledge of Vietnamese cuisine, and he gets an indepth street food 101 tour of the city. From learning about haute Franco-Vietnamese cuisine with the city's best French chefs, to a simple and honest bowl of pho. In this episode, Sashi uncovers the bustling city of Hanoi and all its trappings. Secret alleyways leading to decades old cafes offering famous brews like egg coffee to iconic places that serve French style baguettes and everything in between!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Snappy's Puppet: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs

And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs

Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba

Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

Or maybe each system has a certain order?In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: In 1978, one film changed the face of cinema forever. Long established as one of the most debated and divisive movies of all time, I Spit On Your Grave has been condemned by some as 'vile and depraved', whilst others hail it as a 'misunderstood masterpiece of cinema', 'the ultimate feminist movie'. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: The World's Fastest Indian

With all the odds against him, he set a new speed record and captured the spirit of his times. Burt Munro's 1967 world record remains unbroken and his legend lives on today.

Enter this convent at your own risk!

Fuelled by jealousy, Melissa spirals out of control and concocts a vengeful plot against Abigail. A raw, scandalous fight like no other!

As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God's protection and Derek's assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek's own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Best Mistake 1 : The Movie
programme.desc: Kim Yeon Do (Lee Eun Jae) is a studious high school girl whose life is being made miserable by a boy from her past. Despite all of her efforts, she can't get peace as he won't leave her alone. So she hatches a plan. On her social media pages, she posts a picture of another boy, in the hope that this move will put an end to the irritation. But this move turns out to have unexpected consequences: It turns out that the boy in the picture is actually one of her schoolmates. Named Ji Hyun Ho (Kang Yul), he is a bit of a loose cannon. Although he is very popular, he dislikes studying - and prefers play. The rest of the school soon learns about the social media post, as news spreads fast in the classroom! This leads to a number of run-ins with ji Hyun Ho. But the more they get to know one another, the closer they get - causing yet further complications for a whole host of classmates!

The dream recipe for creating a K-POP idol is now revealed!

programme.title: Ekaant
programme.desc: India is known for its remarkable architecture and serene landscapes. Its rich history is steeped in mystery its vastness - lends itself to several stories and urban legends. Ekaant takes you through the abandoned roads and alleys of some of India's historic locations. Travelling through the spread out palaces and deserted forts, the show documents and investigates the eerie processes of abandonment of each site. How flourishing towns and cities came to be in ruins, is the question each episode seeks to answer. Ekaant explores the ceasing of life and the triumph of nature even in the most populated of places and takes you on the road no longer travelled.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries

Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

Pinki is a fiveyearold girl with a cleft lip, born into a desperately poor family from a village in the Mirzapur District in India. This reallife fairy tale follows Pinkis journey from a life of isolation and ostracism to a smile of joy.

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF's Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly's ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky's own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly's horse wins the race. At Louisville's Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

Quando, però, la lava e le ceneri scatenano paura e sfiducia tra tutti, non sono solo i vulcani a essere pericolosi. Tutti devono imparare a collaborare se vogliono sopravvivere a questo epico volo di fuoco.

programme.title: Il regno di Wuba
programme.desc: Uomini e mostri non possono convivere in armonia: i primi, per paura o per diletto, finiranno sempre per andare a caccia dei secondi. Consapevole di questo, la Regina dei Mostri, incinta e minacciata di morte, fa di tutto per preservare la salute del nascituro.

programme.title: Alieni in soffitta
